task_message:
Case L16: segment the lipomatous soft-tissue tumor on this T1-weighted MRI.

Volume: 201x201x157 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is finished.

**Summary:** I segmented a large, well-defined lipomatous soft-tissue mass (T1-hyperintense, encapsulated, intramuscular with mass effect on the adjacent muscle), 288.4 mL in one connected component, spanning axial slices 18–115. I verified the boundary against the fat/muscle interface in axial, coronal and sagittal planes, checked both superior and inferior ends (the lesion tapers to a small focus at its top and ends before axial 123), and evaluated all automatic candidates — each was normal subcutaneous/intermuscular fat adjacent to the lesion, so none were accepted. Confidence: medium (boundary is clearly correct, but a second lobulated superficial fat lobule on the opposite side of the limb was judged normal fat rather than a separate tumor component).
